title: Lexxir Guild / Legacy Artificial Life Division
summary: Restricted record concerning the Lexxir division directed by Hephaestus Rigel and associated with Zephyr's model line.
body:
SUBJECT

LEXXIR GUILD / LEGACY ARTIFICIAL LIFE DIVISION

A restricted internal division of the Lexxir Guild is referenced in documentation concerning legacy artificial-life systems.

The division is directed by Hephaestus Rigel. Novacliss is identified as one of the researchers working under his direction.

The division is associated with the creation and modification of legacy artificial individuals. One model connected to the division is Zephyr.

The surviving documentation does not establish the full history of the division or the complete extent of its work.
